title: Conceding a Point Before Answering
goal: Concede part of an opponent's case before pivoting to a rebuttal using es cierto que... sin embargo / no obstante and si bien.
grammar: concession with es cierto que... sin embargo / no obstante and si bien + indicative

items: I can concede a factual point with *es cierto que* and pivot with *sin embargo* or *no obstante*.
I can pack a formal concession into an opening *si bien* + indicative clause without adding *pero*.
I can use debate terms for concessions, fallacies, consensus, allusions and forceful counter-rebuttals.
